fact: Laws 046.26 on the national statistical system and 047.26 on the HCP were promulgated by dahirs of 28 July 2026 and published in the Bulletin officiel of 10 August 2026; law 046.26 enters into force at the first meeting of the deliberative body of the new Conseil national de l'information statistique.
title: Réforme du système statistique: ce qui change au Maroc
